# Limye' Foundation

> Illuminating Pathways to Community Prosperity across Tuscaloosa and West Alabama.

Limye' Foundation is a community-driven 501(c)(3) pending nonprofit organization committed to addressing interconnected health, housing, and social security needs. Through an integrated service framework—combining supportive housing, white-glove Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT), and Medically Tailored Meals (MTM)—Limye' Foundation empowers vulnerable individuals and families to break cycles of poverty and health disparity.

## Key Information
- **Legal Business Name**: Limye' Foundation
- **Associated Entity**: Porch Light Foundation
- **Founder**: Quincy Ruffin
- **Primary Location**: Tuscaloosa, Alabama (Serving West Alabama)
- **Status**: 501(c)(3) Nonprofit (Filing Pending Approval)
- **Primary Domain**: https://limyefoundation.org
- **Contact Email**: QRuffin@limyefoundation.org
- **Contact Phone**: +1 (205) 393-7396

## Primary Capabilities & Services
- **Supportive Housing**: Safe, affordable housing linked with wrap-around case management, healthcare access, and life skills training.
- **Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT)**: Reliable, white-glove transportation removing mobility barriers to healthcare, employment, and essential services.
- **Medically Tailored Meals (MTM)**: Home delivery of customized nutrition for individuals managing chronic conditions (e.g., diabetes, hypertension) and food insecurity.
- **Community Resource Integration**: Co-located partnership with New Heights Community Resource Center to provide wrap-around care coordination.
